description.en:
Dexforce W1 Pro is a wheeled, dual-arm humanoid development platform for embodied-intelligence applications. Its configurable structure includes lifting, rotation and pitching at the torso, with alternative mobile bases, arms, grippers and dexterous hands to suit different tasks.

Stereo and wrist vision support object perception, while optional wrist force sensors provide feedback for compliant manipulation. The manufacturer describes EtherCAT networking and high-frequency joint control, together with navigation and spoken interaction. W1 Pro also connects to Dexforce's EmbodiChain development workflow for generating training data, building vision-language-action models and transferring them to the physical robot. The exact sensing, payload and computing configuration depends on the selected hardware.
